title: Inception Releases Mercury 3 Diffusion LLM at 1,068 Tokens per Second
summary: Inception released Mercury 3, a diffusion LLM it says runs at 1,068 tokens per second with a 1M-token context. On Inception’s own table it leads GPT-6 Luna and Claude Haiku 5.5 on 8 of 12 benchmarks. The post Inception Releases Mercury 3 Diffusion LLM at 1,068 Tokens per Second appeared first on MarkTechPost .
